package cmd

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/rsa"
	"crypto/x509"
	"encoding/pem"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/info"
	"go.uber.org/zap/zaptest"
)

func TestNewGRPCServer(t *testing.T) {
	tmp := t.TempDir()
	cfg := &config.Config{}
	cfg.Database.URL = fmt.Sprintf("file:%s", filepath.Join(tmp, "flipt.db"))
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	t.Cleanup(cancel)
	s, err := NewGRPCServer(ctx, zaptest.NewLogger(t), cfg, info.Flipt{}, false)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		err := s.Shutdown(ctx)
		assert.NoError(t, err)
	})
	assert.NotEmpty(t, s.Server.GetServiceInfo())
}

func TestAuthenticationGRPCJWTWithoutDatabase(t *testing.T) {
	key, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	keyPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "public.pem")
	publicKey, err := x509.MarshalPKIXPublicKey(&key.PublicKey)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	keyPEM := pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "PUBLIC KEY", Bytes: publicKey})
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(keyPath, keyPEM, 0600))

	for _, storageType := range []config.StorageType{config.LocalStorageType, config.GitStorageType, config.OCIStorageType} {
		t.Run(string(storageType), func(t *testing.T) {
			cfg := &config.Config{}
			cfg.Storage.Type = storageType
			cfg.Database.URL = "invalid://database"
			cfg.Authentication.Required = true
			cfg.Authentication.Methods.JWT.Enabled = true
			cfg.Authentication.Methods.JWT.Method.PublicKeyFile = keyPath
			cfg.Authentication.Methods.JWT.Cleanup = &config.AuthenticationCleanupSchedule{}

			register, interceptors, shutdown, err := authenticationGRPC(context.Background(), zaptest.NewLogger(t), cfg, false, false)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Len(t, register, 2)
			require.NotEmpty(t, interceptors)
			require.NoError(t, shutdown(context.Background()))
		})
	}
}

item.text:
Authentication now connects to a database only when flag storage uses one or an enabled authentication method requires one. JWT is explicitly marked as database-free; static token, OIDC, GitHub, and Kubernetes are marked as database-backed. Cleanup runs only for enabled database-backed methods with a schedule.

Added tests for method selection and JWT startup with Local, Git, and OCI storage. `go test ./internal/config ./internal/cmd ./internal/cleanup` passed.
